sentences.s: I have a new ruler in my bag.
sentences.sCn: 我的书包里有一把新尺子。

sentences.s: Show me your green pencil.
sentences.sCn: 给我看看你的绿色铅笔。

sentences.s: Can I use your eraser, please?
sentences.sCn: 请问我可以用你的橡皮擦吗？

sentences.s: This is a blue pen.
sentences.sCn: 这是一支蓝色的钢笔。

sentences.s: Carry your school bag happily.
sentences.sCn: 开开心心地背上你的书包。

sentences.s: Open your English book, please.
sentences.sCn: 请打开你的英语书。

sentences.s: Draw a picture with the crayon.
sentences.sCn: 用蜡笔画一幅画。

sentences.s: My pencil box is on the desk.
sentences.sCn: 我的铅笔盒在桌子上。

sentences.s: I see a red apple on the tree.
sentences.sCn: 我看到树上有一个红苹果。

sentences.s: The little duck is yellow.
sentences.sCn: 这只小鸭子是黄色的。

sentences.s: The grass in spring is green.
sentences.sCn: 春天的草地是绿色的。

sentences.s: The sky is clear and blue.
sentences.sCn: 天空晴朗湛蓝。

sentences.s: Orange is my favorite color.
sentences.sCn: 橙色是我最喜欢的颜色。

sentences.s: Snow is pure and white.
sentences.sCn: 雪花是纯白色的。

sentences.s: The cute panda has black eyes.
sentences.sCn: 可爱的大熊猫有一双黑眼睛。

sentences.s: A brown bear lives in the forest.
sentences.sCn: 一只棕熊生活在森林里。

sentences.s: Wash your face every morning.
sentences.sCn: 每天早晨洗洗脸。

sentences.s: Touch your ear gently.
sentences.sCn: 轻轻摸摸你的耳朵。

sentences.s: Close your eyes and make a wish.
sentences.sCn: 闭上眼睛许个愿吧。

sentences.s: The rabbit has a small pink nose.
sentences.sCn: 小兔子有一个粉红粉红的小鼻子。

sentences.s: Open your mouth and say Ah.
sentences.sCn: 张开你的嘴巴说‘啊’。

sentences.s: Wave your arms to say goodbye.
sentences.sCn: 挥挥你的手臂说再见。

sentences.s: Clap your hands together.
sentences.sCn: 大家一起拍拍手。

sentences.s: The giraffe has long legs.
sentences.sCn: 长颈鹿有长长的腿。

sentences.s: Stamp your foot to the music.
sentences.sCn: 跟着音乐跺跺脚。

sentences.s: The cat is catching a toy mouse.
sentences.sCn: 小猫正在抓玩具老鼠。

sentences.s: The loyal dog runs in the garden.
sentences.sCn: 忠诚的小狗在花园里奔跑。

sentences.s: The monkey swings from tree to tree.
sentences.sCn: 小猴子在树枝间荡来荡去。

sentences.s: A lovely panda is chewing bamboo.
sentences.sCn: 一只可爱的大熊猫正在嚼竹子。

sentences.s: Look at the yellow duck in the water.
sentences.sCn: 看看水里的那只黄鸭子。

sentences.s: The little pig has a curly tail.
sentences.sCn: 这只小猪有一根卷卷的尾巴。

sentences.s: The bird sings early in the morning.
sentences.sCn: 小鸟大清早就开始唱歌了。

sentences.s: The fierce tiger is king of beasts.
sentences.sCn: 凶猛的老虎是百兽之王。

sentences.s: An elephant can drink water with its trunk.
sentences.sCn: 大象能用它的鼻子喝水。

sentences.s: I eat buttered bread for breakfast.
sentences.sCn: 我早餐吃抹了黄油的面包。

sentences.s: A cup of fresh orange juice is yummy.
sentences.sCn: 一杯新鲜的橙汁真好喝。

sentences.s: Drink your warm milk before bed.
sentences.sCn: 睡前喝掉你的温牛奶。

sentences.s: Drink plenty of water every day.
sentences.sCn: 每天都要多喝水哦。

sentences.s: Make a wish and cut the cake.
sentences.sCn: 许个愿望然后切蛋糕吧。

sentences.s: Small fish swim freely in the river.
sentences.sCn: 小鱼在河里自由自在地游。

sentences.s: We have delicious rice for lunch.
sentences.sCn: 我们午餐吃香喷喷的米饭。

sentences.s: I have one little puppy.
sentences.sCn: 我有一只小狗。

sentences.s: Birds have two wings to fly.
sentences.sCn: 鸟儿有两只翅膀可以飞翔。

sentences.s: There are three apples on the plate.
sentences.sCn: 盘子里有三个苹果。

sentences.s: A chair has four wooden legs.
sentences.sCn: 一把椅子有四条木头腿。

sentences.s: Give me five, my good friend!
sentences.sCn: 跟我击个掌吧，我的好朋友！

sentences.s: I have six colorful pencils.
sentences.sCn: 我有六支彩色的铅笔。

sentences.s: A rainbow has seven pretty colors.
sentences.sCn: 彩虹有七种美丽的颜色。

sentences.s: An octopus has eight long arms.
sentences.sCn: 一只章鱼有八条长长的腕足。

sentences.s: Nine birds are resting on the branch.
sentences.sCn: 九只小鸟停在树枝上休息。

sentences.s: Count your fingers from one to ten.
sentences.sCn: 从一数到十数数你的手指。
